entities.title: Production
entities.summary: The chess Worker at icelander.net/games/retro/chess*, with the static game, the GameRoom Durable Objects and the D1 database chess.
entities.purpose: The game players reach at icelander.net/games/retro/chess/.
entities.deployedBy: The owner, from their own machine: `npm run deploy` in games/chess (npm test, npm run test:godot, npm run build, wrangler deploy) with Godot 4.7.2 and its web export templates installed, with a Cloudflare token for the icelander.net account (or wrangler logged in to it). Nothing deploys from GitHub's runners: the Deploy workflow was removed (the owner's decision, 2026-11-21).
approvals: The owner's decision: nothing deploys on its own, and only the owner runs the deploy.
A pull request, tested by CI, for anything that reaches main: main accepts nothing else.
entities.rollback: No rollback is recorded: check out an earlier commit and run npm run deploy again, or roll back the Worker's version in Cloudflare. A database change is not undone by this; it is applied by hand and written so the previous code keeps working (docs/database-migrations.md).
entities.details: The Worker's route runs ahead of the games hub's less specific icelander.net/games/*. The Durable Object class GameRoom came with migration rooms-v1, which must stay. One-time set-up (the database, the login service's keys in ACCOUNTS_JWKS, and optionally Resend) is in the README's Deploy section and the runbooks.
